documents.title: Clarification Letter On Price Movement Of Our Securities
Clarification sought from Premier Polyfilm Ltd
Clarification On Significant Increase In Trading Volume Of Our Securities

analysis.summary: Premier Polyfilm Limited reported a net profit of Rs. 2,156 Lakhs for the financial year 2023-2024, supported by improved capacity utilization and cost-saving measures. The company plans to transition toward sustainable energy sources like solar and PNG to align with environmental goals. Management has proposed a sub-division of equity shares from a face value of Rs. 5 to Rs.

guidance.claim: Management expects the company to perform better in the current year, barring unforeseen circumstances.
guidance.quote: Barring unforeseen circumstances, your company will perform better in the current year.

demand_outlook.claim: The company's products continue to be in demand.
demand_outlook.quote: By introducing above R&D formulations has helped the company to reduce cost of new range of colour schemes and designs of finished products the Company’s products continue to be in demand.

capex_expansion.claim: The company achieved higher capacity utilization through the installation of new plant and machinery.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company achieved higher capacity utilization with the installation and utilization of new Plant & Machinery.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to switch to sustainable energy sources like solar and PNG.
capex_expansion.quote: Seeing the Government inclination towards pollution free environment and as per various notifications of Government in this regard,your Company plans to fully switch other sustainable and renewable sources of power/energy such as Solar and PNG energy inaddition to available current source of power energy available with the company during the current financial year.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to switch to sustainable and renewable energy sources such as solar and PNG during the current financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: Seeing the Government inclination towards pollution free environment and as per various notifications of Government in this regard, your Company plans to switch to other sustainable and renewable sources of power/energy such as Solar and PNG energy in addition to available current source of power energy available with the company during the current financial year.

margins_costs.claim: Profitability improved due to cheaper raw material procurement and reduced finance costs.
margins_costs.quote: The reasons for increase in cash profit during the current quarter and year ended on 31st March,2024 was mainly due to that company could arrange raw material at cheaper rate and sold the finished goods at existing sales prices i.e. the prices of finished goods were not changed/devalued.

margins_costs.claim: The company reduced finance costs by arranging cheaper loans.
margins_costs.quote: Secondly productions of some of the items of finished goods which were not generated good profits were stopped and to some extent company could arrange cheaper loan from other bank i.e. Yes Bank Limited and hence finance cost was also reduced.

orders_capacity.claim: The company produced 27,133 M.T. of PVC products during the year.
orders_capacity.quote: During the period under review your company produced 27,133 M.T. of PVC flooring, Sheetings, Films etc. as against 26,755 M.T. produced during the previous year.

orders_capacity.claim: The company produced 26,754 M.T. of products during the year, achieving higher capacity utilization through new plant and machinery.
orders_capacity.quote: During the period under review your company produced 26,754 M.T. of PVC flooring, Sheetings, Films etc. as against 23,414 M.T. produced during the previous year. The Company achieved higher capacity utilization with the installation and utilization of new Plant & Machinery.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a dividend of 15% for the financial year 2023-2024.
capital_allocation.quote: “RESOLVED THAT a dividend of 15% (Rs.0.75 per equity share of Rs. 5/-) as recommended by the Board of Directors be and is hereby declared out of the profits of the Company for the financial year 2023-2024.”

capital_allocation.claim: The company proposed a sub-division of equity shares from Rs. 5 to Rs. 1 face value.
capital_allocation.quote: In order to provide enhanced liquidity in the capital market through widening shareholder base and to make it more affordable for small investors, it is proposed to sub-divide, Rs 5 /- each fully paid into Rs. 1/- each fully paid Equity Shares each pursuant to the provisions of Section 61(1)(d) of the Act, the rules made there under and other applicable provisions.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a dividend of Rs. 0.50 per equity share for the year ended March 31, 2023.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of your company is pleased to recommend for your approval payment of dividend @ 0.50 per equity share of Rs.5/- each (i.e. 10%) for the year ended on 31st March, 2023 subject to deduction of Tax at Source

capital_allocation.claim: The company transferred Rs. 400 Lakhs to General Reserves during the year.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year under review, the Board has transferred an amount of Rs.400 Lakhs to General Reserves.

risks_headwinds.claim: Lower profitability in the past was attributed to economic slowdown and adverse market conditions.
risks_headwinds.quote: Due to economic slowdown and consequent adverse market conditions prevailing, there was lower profitability in the Company.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company experienced significant fluctuations in raw material prices after the end of the financial year.
risks_headwinds.quote: There were no material changes and commitments affecting the financial position of the company between the end of financial year to which these financial statements relate and as on the date of this Report except steep flucatutation in the prices of raw material.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to switch to sustainable energy sources during the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: Seeing the Government inclination towards pollution free environment and as per various notifications of Government in this regard,your Company plans to fully switch other sustainable and renewable sources of power/energy such as Solar and PNG energy inaddition to available current source of power energy available with the company during the current financial year.
